version.changelog:
- Added version field and updated the skill description in SKILL.md for clarity and detail.
- Strengthened security documentation: emphasized read-only access and pinned dependency version.
- Updated prerequisites and dependency instructions to require `PyGithub==2.8.1`.
- Removed test files (`tests/conftest.py` and `tests/test_github_checks.py`) for a leaner package.
- No changes to user commands; overall functionality remains the same.

llm.summary: The skill's required files, environment variable, and runtime actions are consistent with a GitHub compliance evidence collector; nothing in the package suggests hidden exfiltration or unrelated privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (GitHub compliance evidence) align with the code and declared requirements: python3, GITHUB_TOKEN, and PyGithub. The checks implemented (branch protection, secret scanning, Dependabot, 2FA, deploy keys, audit logs, webhooks, CODEOWNERS, CI/CD) legitimately require the GitHub API access the skill requests.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and code call only GitHub APIs and operate on ~/.openclaw/grc/compliance.sqlite (store evidence, update integration status). They also attempt to invoke auditclaw-grc's scripts/db_query.py if present. This behavior is coherent with the described purpose, but users should note the skill will write into the specified local GRC database (direct sqlite inserts as a fallback) and will update the 'integrations' record for provider='github'.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No packaged install spec; SKILL.md instructs pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt (PyGithub pinned). No remote downloads or obscured installers. Code files are included with the skill; installation is standard Python dependency installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only GITHUB_TOKEN is required (declared). The token scopes described (repo, read:org, security_events / equivalent fine-grained read-only permissions) are appropriate for the checks performed. No unrelated secrets or system credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated platform privileges. It does write evidence and update integration status in the shared GRC sqlite DB (~/.openclaw/grc/compliance.sqlite) — this is expected for a GRC integrator but is persistent behavior that the user should accept explicitly. The skill does not modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to do what it says: run read-only GitHub checks and store results in your AuditClaw GRC database. Before installing or running it: (1) Create a token with the minimum read-only scopes recommended and set it as GITHUB_TOKEN. (2) Run the --test-connection first to confirm scopes and rate-limit behavior. (3) Ensure auditclaw-grc is installed if you want db_query.py integration; otherwise the skill will perform a direct sqlite insert into ~/.openclaw/grc/compliance.sqlite — back up that DB beforehand. (4) Be aware some checks (audit log, member 2FA lists) may require admin/Enterprise privileges and will fail or return limited data if the token is insufficient. (5) Review scripts/github-permissions.json and, if you need extra assurance, inspect scripts/github_evidence.py and the auditclaw-grc db_query.py (if present) to confirm the exact DB schema and update behavior.
